24.text: Roots are eaten raw, added to meat-soup as vegetables, or pounded fine,

25.text: together with the choicest meat and tallow, and made into a pudding, which

26.text: is considered the most delicious dish of the Chukchee bill of fare.

27.text: Berries are gathered and eaten on the spot. They are very seldom stored,

28.text: since the tundra is not very rich in berries. Those occurring most frequently

29.text: are Empetrum nigrum and Rubus chamæmorus.
